title: ROSTrans: Empirically Benchmarking LLMs for ROS1-to-ROS2 Migration
abstract: arXiv:2610.41168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although large language models have shown strong capabilities in domain-specific code generation, their performance in robotics software development, especially for the Robot Operating System (ROS), remains largely unexplored. ROS code generation presents distinctive challenges, including complex inter-node coordination, middleware configuration, and lifecycle semantics that go far beyond standard coding benchmarks, and many important correctness properties become observable only once migrated nodes are launched and communicate. We present ROSTrans, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on ROS1-to-ROS2 code migration, a representative and practically important setting for ROS code generation. ROSTrans comprises 108 scaffolded completion tasks drawn from a diverse set of 70+ open-source ROS1 repositories and organized into a hierarchical taxonomy assessing interface-level, behavioral-level and system-level correctness. translated_title: ROSTrans：面向ROS1到ROS2迁移的大语言模型实证基准测试
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型在特定领域的代码生成中已展现出强大的能力，但其在机器人软件开发中的表现，尤其是在机器人操作系统（ROS）方面，仍在很大程度上未被探索。ROS代码生成带来了独特的挑战，包括复杂的节点间协调、中间件配置以及远超标准编程基准的生命周期语义，而且许多重要的正确性属性只有在迁移后的节点被启动并进行通信时才能被观察到。我们提出了ROSTrans，一个用于评估大语言模型在ROS1到ROS2代码迁移任务上表现的基准测试，这是ROS代码生成中一个具有代表性且具有重要实际意义的场景。ROSTrans包含108个脚手架式代码补全任务，这些任务源自70多个多样化的开源ROS1代码库，并被组织成一个分层分类体系，用于评估接口级、行为级和系统级的正确性。对于每个任务，我们建立了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了ROSTrans基准，通过包含108个源自70多个开源ROS1代码库的脚手架式补全任务，并以接口级、行为级和系统级正确性的分层分类体系，实证评估大语言模型在ROS1到ROS2代码迁移上的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ROSTrans, a benchmark of 108 scaffolded completion tasks drawn from 70+ open-source ROS1 repositories, organized into a hierarchical taxonomy assessing interface-level, behavioral-level, and system-level correctness, to empirically evaluate LLMs on ROS1-to-ROS2 code migration.
